Features

Every AI capability, in one place

The agent workbench keeps every working coding agent in view; models, tools and Nomi's own skills live here too.

Download Nomi
Core capabilities

Six core capabilities

Outcomes first: fewer windows, less config, visibility when things break, safer file changes.

01

Many assistants, one window

Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, and dsh side by side — plus your own via a command. Stop hopping between terminals.

02

Switch without losing the thread

Take over sessions and hot-switch assistants; progress continues — no re-explaining context.

03

Picks the right path

Chooses models and routes for the task; fails over when a line drops — less hand-picking, less protocol setup.

04

Set once, use everywhere

Chat and work share providers and assignments; helpers, concurrency, and fallbacks in one place.

05

More sources, steadier

Multiple providers and keys, plus local models — cloud or offline, your way.

06

See it, stay in control

Quality stats for success and latency; permission modes and a sandbox before files change — sensitive steps still need your OK.

Agent board

  • Nomi's chats and background runs, dispatched and workbench coding agents, and sessions from a terminal or IDE (read-only), all in one place.
  • Cards show status, source, folder, CPU and memory; anything waiting on you comes first.
  • When memory runs low it pauses the coding agents Nomi dispatched and resumes them where they stopped; pause and resume by hand any time.

Coding agents

  • Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and dsh in tabs — plus external ACP assistants you add.
  • Nomi can hand off development, docs, review and research; watch progress, approve or stop in chat.
  • Switch official accounts anytime; Agent Profiles for cheap or local tiers.
  • Three columns: sessions, chat & Diff, Changes · Files — full-screen review and undo this turn’s writes.
  • Model quality comparison and unified permission modes; a harder sandbox so file changes feel safer.

Local-first, any model

  • Switch OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, and more.
  • Run local models too, and optionally let only local models read your files.
  • Data is stored locally by default; API keys are encrypted and secrets are protected before they leave.

Automation & MCP

  • Read, search, and summarize files you authorize.
  • Manage MCP servers and skill packs; import from Claude Code / Codex.
  • Sensitive actions ask first; deletes are undoable and audited.

Chat & image Q&A

  • Streaming chat in a calm, uncluttered window.
  • Paste or drag images into the input to ask about them.
  • Cloud models ask for your OK before receiving images for the first time.

Knowledge & memory

  • Answers from your folders, with clickable citations.
  • PDF, Word, Markdown, and on-device OCR for images.
  • Memories and profile you can view, edit, and delete.

Desktop character (optional)

  • Full-body Rive character with expressions, gestures and lip-sync.
  • Resize it, or close it any time; the workbench works the same.
  • Offline or streaming voice input, or plug in your own TTS.
